review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Troubleshoot and resolve complex network and application connectivity issues during Cloud9 migrations, acting as escalation point for the team. 5+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, including large-scale data center and cloud migrations. Excellent troubleshooting, documentation and communication skills, with fluent English.
eligibility_evidence: Descripción del puesto: About the Role_ As a Senior Network Engineer, you will lead key parts of large-scale data center and cloud migration initiatives, ensuring secure, reliable and efficient network operations across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Experience designing hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure, GCP and/or OCI).

Our Core values are focus to inclusion and diversity, all qualified applicants will be considered for employment and will go thru a fair recruitment process regardless of their race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin or disability status.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The expertise requested_ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, including large-scale data center and cloud migrations. Strong hands-on experience with AWS networking: VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, security groups, NACLs and egress/proxy patterns. Strong hands-on experience with Azure networking: VNets, peering, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, NSGs, Load Balancer/Application Gateway and Private Link. Desired or nice to have expertise_ Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700).
